image.name: github-desktop
image.description: [Github Desktop](https://desktop.github.com/) is an open source Electron-based GitHub app. It is written in TypeScript and uses React.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Use Wayland ozone platform flag for apps fixes scaling and acceleration.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.
Rebase to Bookworm and multi arch.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: HTTP Github Desktop gui, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for electron applications to function properly.

image.title: Github-desktop
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  github-desktop:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/github-desktop:latest
    container_name: github-desktop
    cap_add:
      - IPC_LOCK
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/github-desktop/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=github-desktop \
  --cap-add=IPC_LOCK \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/github-desktop/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/github-desktop:latest
